name: domaine
description: Domaine marketplace for Claude Code plugins.

plugins.name: fnd
plugins.description: Legacy, frozen at 0.135.0, supported until 2027-06-30 — Domaine Foundation skills, the Agentic Assisted Development workflow for Shopify theme work (new Claude Code installs: slim, band, base, fe).

plugins.name: slim
plugins.description: Universal result proxy for Claude Code — compresses large MCP, Bash, Read, WebFetch, WebSearch, Grep, Glob and Agent results, pasted prompt data and @-mentioned files by content (JSON, logs, HTML, Figma REST node trees, plain-text windows), guards spill reads, and adds two tools: lookup answers one question about a page, command or file; view compacts a file or a command output (with jq narrowing, media resize and video frames) into a workspace file.

plugins.name: band
plugins.description: Status band, Log pane and Progress pane for Claude Code: draws the session's figures above the prompt and the event log and task checklist that base, fnd, slim and the team plugins publish; reads base, fnd, slim and the team plugins' state.

plugins.name: base
plugins.description: Shared Domaine plugin for Claude Code: the Jira, Figma and doc readers, the Jira writer and the review agents, the task workspace and the progress it publishes for band, the commit and review guards, the working conventions, a doctor, and the shared MCP servers; requires slim, never runs with fnd.

plugins.name: fe
plugins.description: Domaine frontend team plugin for Claude Code: the Shopify theme skills (ship, preview theme, steps to test, TA, breaking changes, translations, PR), the theme-explorer agent, project profile and store access; requires base (and slim through it)

plugins.name: qa
plugins.description: Domaine QA team plugin for Claude Code: the preflight skill (Jira ticket, PR and store facts, a storefront unlocked on the theme under test, Steps to Test pre-run at desktop and mobile, a brief in the house style) and the read-only store-access posture; requires base (and slim through it)

plugins.name: be
plugins.description: Domaine backend team plugin for Claude Code: the Shopify app and extension skills (app scope with LOE, Shopify resources, platform limitations and workarounds); requires base (and slim through it)

plugins.name: pm
plugins.description: Domaine project-management plugin for Claude Code: the project estimator, the estimator pre-submission review, the merchant brief, solutions engineering (scoping, implementation plan, LOE, handoff) and vendor evaluation skills; requires base (and slim through it)
